libbinder.so.Parcel::readAligned<: The factory build emits Parcel::readAligned<T> out of line; the Source compiler inlines the identical template body (same validateReadData / NOT_ENOUGH_DATA logic). Inlining difference, no consumer.
libbinder.so.Parcel::unsafeReadTypedVector<: Template instantiation emitted by the Source compiler only; same Parcel code.
libbinder.so.unique_fd_impl: libc++ vector instantiation emitted by the Source compiler only.
libbinder.so.shared_ptr: Stale VNDK copy in the product output from before the FreezeManager rewrite; the rebuilt vendor variant has no shared_ptr registry.
libbinder.so.SceneInfoManager|SceneData|ISceneInfoMan: Ported (chunk 6); consumer /system/bin/pxrmediametrics. Listed only while the product VNDK copy is stale.
libbinder.so.FreezeManager|containsKey|android::mtx|a: Ported (chunk 6), factory remote registry reproduced. Listed only while the product VNDK copy is stale.
libbinder.so.ProcessState|IPCThreadState|BBinder::set: Ported (chunk 6). Listed only while the product VNDK copy is stale.

libhwui.so.RenderProxy::(setSurface|doAnimation|not: Only consumer is the factory libandroid_runtime (HardwareRenderer nDoAnimation/nNotifyMonitorStatsChanged, setSurface with a flag), which the Source libandroid_runtime replaces; the Java natives have no consumers (validation/api-consumers.json).
libhwui.so.construction vtable for Gr|GrMock: Skia GrMock construction vtables emitted by the factory compiler; no consumer.
libhwui.so.construction vtable for (android::Thread: Construction vtables emitted by the factory compiler; no consumer.
libhwui.so.__addtf3|__multf3|__subtf3|__floatditf|_: compiler-rt long double builtins linked into the factory arm64 libhwui; no consumer.

libmedia_jni.so.register_android_media_SpatialCoordConve: Factory registration of android.media.SpatialCoordConverter natives; the Java class has no consumer outside framework.jar (validation/api-consumers.json) and is not part of the 9 needed natives.

libandroid_runtime.so.ExtSurfaceImpl|tempMemFor2DVrBits: Factory JNI of android.view.ExtSurfaceImpl 2D-VR canvas (lock/unlock for 2D VR, release); the Java natives have no consumer (not_needed in validation/api-consumers.json). The Source VR canvas path goes through Surface (validation/vr-canvas-api.json).
libandroid_runtime.so.getBinderClientPids|getBinderServerPids: Factory JNI for Binder client/server PID queries; the libbinder side is ported (IPCThreadState::getBinder*Pids), the Java natives are only reachable from the preserved sys-/sysmonitor- JARs, which are not on the Source classpath.
libandroid_runtime.so.android_os_Process_(useCGroupFreeze|setU: Smartisan process freeze/scheduling JNI used only by the preserved sys-/sysmonitor- JARs (needed_by_preserved_factory_component); not on the Source SYSTEMSERVERCLASSPATH, see REMAINING-WORK.
libandroid_runtime.so.seemp|Seemp: CodeLinaro SEEMP logging JNI; no consumer.
libandroid_runtime.so.AudioDeviceAttributes|AudioDeviceTypeAdd: JNI helpers of the backported AudioSystem spatializer natives (canBeSpatialized/getSpatializer); the Java natives have no consumer.
libandroid_runtime.so.dmabufinfo: libmeminfo dmabuf helpers statically linked into the factory android_os_Debug; the Debug natives using them have no consumer.
libandroid_runtime.so.NativeDisplayEventReceiver: Factory NativeDisplayEventReceiver constructor with an extra PICO parameter; internal to libandroid_runtime.
libandroid_runtime.so.sensors_timeutil: Namespace of a static sensors time helper differs (factory global, Source android::); internal.
libandroid_runtime.so.javaAttachThread: Consumer (factory libsensorservice) is replaced by Source.
